# A Code tag shows a file as a fenced code block, so a page cannot drift
# from the program it documents.

md2html -html out -llms -search -include-root . docs
grep -q 'fmt' out/guide.html
grep -q 'Println' out/guide.html
grep -q 'data-language="Go"' out/guide.html
! grep -q 'region greet' out/guide.html

# A tag inside a fence is an example, and is left alone.
grep -q 'shown-as-text.go' out/guide.html
! grep -q 'class="admonition adm-danger"' out/guide.html

# A region is shown without its markers or its indentation, and a
# relative src is resolved against the page.
grep -q '<div class="md-code-title">Greeting</div>' out/guide.html
grep -q 'beside' out/guide.html

# With link, the caption links to the file in the repository docs.json
# names, at the lines shown.
grep -q '<a href="https://github.com/example/project/blob/v1.2.0/examples/hello/main.go#L7">examples/hello/main.go</a>' out/guide.html

# The Markdown that readers and tools get has the code in it.
grep -q 'fmt.Println' out/guide.md
! grep -q '<Code src="/examples' out/guide.md
grep -q '<Code src="shown-as-text.go" />' out/guide.md
grep -q 'fmt.Println' out/llms-full.txt

# A site whose navigation is SUMMARY.md can still name its repository
# in docs.json.
md2html -html summaryout -nav -include-root . summarydocs
grep -q '<a href="https://github.com/example/project/blob/HEAD/examples/hello/main.go#L7">examples/hello/main.go</a>' summaryout/page.html

# By default the include root is the source directory, so the same page
# cannot reach the examples above it. The build fails, and the page says
# why where the code would be.
! md2html -html narrow docs
stderr 'include guide.md:5: examples/hello/main.go: no such file'
grep -q 'Code: examples/hello/main.go: no such file' narrow/guide.html

# A file that is missing, outside the root, hidden, or kept out of the
# site by the ignore file is an error too.
! md2html -html bad -include-root . baddocs
stderr 'include page.md:3: baddocs/gone.go: no such file'
stderr 'include page.md:5: ../../outside.go: outside the include root'
stderr 'include page.md:7: .secret: hidden files cannot be included'
stderr 'include page.md:9: baddocs/private/key.go: excluded by the ignore file'
stderr 'include page.md:11: /examples/hello/main.go: no region nope'
stderr 'include page.md:13: unknown attribute symbol'
grep -q 'class="admonition adm-danger"' bad/page.html

# The line of a failing tag counts the page's frontmatter.
stderr 'include front.md:5: baddocs/gone.go: no such file'

# The server shows the same error in the page instead of failing.
cd baddocs
md2html -http :9145 -include-root .. &
wait-port :9145
curl -s http://localhost:9145/page
stdout 'Code: baddocs/gone.go: no such file'
stdout 'class="admonition adm-danger"'
cd ..

# A single page served on its own includes files beside it at the root
# URL, as at its own.
md2html -http :9146 docs/guide.md &
wait-port :9146
curl -s http://localhost:9146/
stdout '<span class="nb">echo</span> beside'
! stdout 'files cannot be included here'

-- docs/docs.json --
{
  "name": "Project",
  "ref": "v1.2.0",
  "navbar": {
    "primary": {"type": "github", "href": "https://github.com/example/project"}
  },
  "navigation": {"pages": ["guide"]}
}
-- docs/guide.md --
# Guide

The whole program:

<Code src="/examples/hello/main.go" />

Only the greeting:

<Code src="/examples/hello/main.go" region="greet" title="Greeting" />

<Code src="/examples/hello/main.go" region="greet" link />

A script beside this page:

<Code src="run.sh" />

Write it like this:

```mdx
<Code src="shown-as-text.go" />
```
-- docs/run.sh --
echo beside
-- examples/hello/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	// region greet
	fmt.Println("hello")
	// endregion greet
}
-- outside.go --
package outside
-- baddocs/.md2htmlignore --
private/
-- baddocs/.secret --
secret
-- baddocs/private/key.go --
package private
-- summarydocs/docs.json --
{
  "navbar": {
    "primary": {"type": "github", "href": "https://github.com/example/project"}
  }
}
-- summarydocs/SUMMARY.md --
# Summary

- [Page](page.md)
-- summarydocs/page.md --
# Page

<Code src="/examples/hello/main.go" region="greet" link />
-- baddocs/front.md --
---
title: Front
---

<Code src="gone.go" />
-- baddocs/page.md --
# Page

<Code src="gone.go" />

<Code src="../../outside.go" />

<Code src=".secret" />

<Code src="private/key.go" />

<Code src="/examples/hello/main.go" region="nope" />

<Code src="/examples/hello/main.go" symbol="main" />
